items.t: Ulta Beauty (ULTA) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump As Analysts Turn More Constructive
items.sum: Ulta Beauty’s updated fair value estimate has shifted from US$631.44 to US$646.96, signaling a modest reset in how analysts frame the stock’s potential. That move sits alongside a more constructive tone in recent research, with some firms lifting their price targets into the US$665 to US$766 range, while others emphasize execution risks and channel mix questions.
